16.name: Benthic fish
16.source_definition: Appendix B: Benthic fish. This group is identical to the Field (2004) benthic fish group and as Field mentions, this is a “catch-all” of benthic species. The group includes eelpouts (Zoarcidae), snailfish (Cyclopteridae), poachers (Agonidae), sculpins (cottidae), tomcod (Microgadus proximus), and spotted ratfish (Hydrolagus colliei). PB, QB, EE, and diet values were taken from Field (2004) and top-down balancing was used to determine the density of this group.
16.finding: Mostly invertebrate animal prey with detritus0.017; no explicit producer consumption. Preserve all parameters.
